text: My general anxiety went down quite a bit and I'm more grateful for what I have. I used to wake up with a knot in my stomach every morning, now that's rare. I appreciate small things more, coffee on the balcony, a chat with my neighbour.
Auch hier keine Veränderung

I felt an incredible amount of love during the experience, for my family, my friends, even strangers. That feeling stayed with me in a softer form. I'm happier and I appreciate the people in my life so much more.

It has improved my mental health in the sense that I understand myself better. I've had depression on and off since my teens and always felt it was just something wrong with me. After the experience, I see it more as a response to what I went through as a kid. That has made me kinder to myself. I'm still in therapy, and the experience gave me a lot of material to work with. My depressive episodes have become shorter and less intense, I think because I don't add self-hatred on top of the sadness anymore. I'm not cured, but I'm in a much better place.
Ich bin offener für neue Erfahrungen und Menschen geworden und urteile weniger schnell.

Negatively. After the experience I had derealisation for months, the world felt fake and I was scared I had damaged my brain. I also had a lot of anxiety and couldn't concentrate at university. It has slowly gotten better, with the help of a therapist, but I'm still not completely back to how I was before the trip.
Happier overall

Die Erfahrung hat meine psychische Gesundheit sehr positiv beeinflusst. Ich hatte vorher oft depressive Phasen, in denen ich mich leer und wertlos gefühlt habe. Während der Erfahrung habe ich eine tiefe Liebe gespürt, für mich selbst, für meine Familie und für alles Lebendige. Ich hatte das Gefühl, mit allem verbunden zu sein und nie wirklich allein zu sein. Dieses Gefühl ist geblieben, nicht so intensiv wie damals, aber es ist da, wenn ich es brauche. Ich bin dankbarer für mein Leben, für meine Gesundheit und meine Freunde, und ich genieße die kleinen Dinge viel mehr. Die depressiven Phasen sind seltener geworden und nicht mehr so tief.

For about two weeks after the experience I felt amazing, light and happy and full of energy. Then slowly it went back to normal, and now I'd say I'm about the same as before. Meditation helps a bit to keep some of it.
I care less about a lot of things now. Not in a bad or good way, it's just flatter. Things that used to upset me or excite me don't really move me anymore.
Meine Depression ist deutlich besser geworden, ich habe wieder Antrieb.

I feel more open and connected to people. I used to be very closed off and suspicious, now I'm curious about others and I've made a couple of new friends. I feel warmer inside, if that makes sense. I've stopped assuming the worst about people and it has made me a lot happier.

The biggest impact on my mental health is that I've developed a deep appreciation for being alive. Before the experience I was going through life on autopilot, I was quite cynical and saw most things as pointless. I wasn't depressed exactly, more like grey. The experience broke that open. I remember sitting in the grass afterwards and crying because the light in the trees was so beautiful, and I realised that I had stopped seeing beauty years ago. Since then I make an effort to notice things: the smell of rain, my daughter's laugh, the taste of a really good apple. It sounds small, but it has changed everything about how I feel day to day. I'm more present, more grateful, and I genuinely enjoy my life. I also feel more love for the people around me, and less irritation. I think the cynicism was a kind of protection, and I don't need it anymore.

Ich verstehe mich selbst und meine Gefühle besser. Ich weiß jetzt, dass viele meiner Ängste aus meiner Kindheit kommen und nicht mit meinem heutigen Leben zu tun haben. Das hilft mir, sie nicht so ernst zu nehmen.
Not much impact on that

I feel much more love and compassion, for myself and for others. I've always been hard on myself and during the experience I felt this huge wave of love for the little girl I used to be. That has stayed with me. I talk to myself more kindly, I'm more patient with my kids and my partner, and I feel like there is more warmth in my life in general. My mood is more stable and I'm generally a lot happier than I was before.
Nach der Erfahrung ging es mir ein paar Tage sehr gut, danach war alles wieder wie vorher.
More open minded about everything

My mental health has improved a lot. I used to have anxiety and anger issues, and I was always on edge. Since the experience my anxiety is much lower, I'd say I went from a 7 out of 10 to a 3 out of 10 on most days. I understand where my anger comes from, which has made it less scary and easier to manage. I think the biggest change is that I'm not ashamed of myself anymore. I used to think I was a bad person because of my temper, now I see that I was a scared kid who learned to protect himself. With that understanding, I can have compassion for myself, and that has helped more than anything else. I've also started seeing a therapist, which I never would have done before, because I didn't think I deserved help. My relationship has improved and I feel more connected to my partner and my friends. Overall I would say I'm healthier and happier than I've been in my adult life.
Ich bin dankbarer für mein Leben und genieße es mehr. Die Erfahrung hat mir gezeigt, wie kostbar jeder Tag ist.

I don't feel much about it anymore. The experience was intense at the time, but now I look back and it's just something that happened. My mental health is the same as before, I'm not more or less happy. I guess I'm a bit more indifferent to things in general, but I'm not sure that's because of the trip.
I feel a lot more love and joy in my daily life. Happier than ever.

Meine Trauer ist leichter geworden, und ich habe nicht mehr so oft depressive Tage. Ich konnte endlich anfangen, den Tod meiner Schwester zu verarbeiten, und habe danach auch eine Trauergruppe besucht. Ich fühle mich stabiler und habe wieder mehr Lebensfreude. Manchmal kommt die Trauer zurück, aber sie überwältigt mich nicht mehr.
I appreciate my life and the people in it much more. I'm also more open to new ideas and perspectives, I don't feel the need to be right all the time. This has made me calmer and happier in general.
Less anxious, more stable
Ich habe mehr Liebe für mich und andere Menschen in mir. Ich fühle mich mit meiner Familie und meinen Freunden enger verbunden und bin insgesamt viel glücklicher als früher.
Not much on my mental health per se. I was already fairly healthy before. It was more of a learning experience about my body.

I would say the experience improved my mental health quite significantly, but not in a magical way. It gave me a deep understanding of why I am the way I am, which I couldn't get from years of talking therapy. Knowing that my hypervigilance, my control issues and my exhaustion are all connected to my childhood has helped me to let go of the idea that I'm just weak or broken. Since then I've had fewer burnout episodes and my mood is more stable. I sleep better because I'm not constantly on alert. I've also become more compassionate with myself and others. I still have bad days, but I can recognise them for what they are and I don't panic. Something I didn't expect: I started to feel much more connected to people, I have more empathy for my parents and I've reconnected with my brother, who I hadn't talked to in years. I feel like I have a better foundation now. My therapist says the change has been remarkable and I agree, though I think a lot of the work happened after the experience, in integrating it.
Etwas stabiler, weniger Grübeln

For a few weeks I felt really good, more optimistic and energetic. But that faded, and now I'm basically back to my baseline. I still remember the feeling and sometimes that helps, but it didn't last the way I hoped it would.
I feel more appreciative of the little things in life, and I'm more satisfied with what I have.

Ich bin offener geworden, sowohl für andere Menschen als auch für neue Ideen. Früher war ich sehr festgefahren in meinen Ansichten und habe vieles abgelehnt, was ich nicht kannte. Jetzt bin ich neugieriger und interessiere mich für Dinge, die ich früher abgetan hätte, z.B. Meditation oder andere Kulturen.

My mental health has improved because I feel loved and connected. During the experience I felt this overwhelming love for everyone, and I think it opened my heart in a way that has stayed. I'm more affectionate with my friends, I tell them I love them, and I feel loved back. I'm also much more grateful for my life and the people in it. I used to feel lonely even when I was surrounded by people, and that's mostly gone. I feel like I belong.
None that I noticed, really

Die Erfahrung hat mir geholfen, mich selbst besser zu verstehen. Ich weiß jetzt, warum ich mich in schwierigen Zeiten so zurückziehe und mich so einsam fühle. Das hat mir viel Druck genommen, weil ich nicht mehr denke, dass mit mir etwas falsch ist. Meine depressive Verstimmung, die mich seit Jahren begleitet hat, ist deutlich leichter geworden. Ich habe mehr Verständnis für mich und kann besser für mich sorgen, z.B. indem ich mir Hilfe hole oder mich mit Freunden treffe, statt mich zu verkriechen.
Opened my mind to different ways of thinking and living. I'm more tolerant and less judgemental of others.
Things don't matter as much to me as they used to. I just shrug.
Ich bin dankbarer und zufriedener mit meinem Leben. Ich genieße die Natur viel mehr und merke, wie gut mir das tut.

I feel more connected to life and to the people I love. My depression has lifted a lot, and I feel a kind of quiet joy that I didn't have before. I'm not saying everything is perfect, but there is a sense of love and connection underneath everything now.
It shook me up a bit at first, I was anxious for a couple of weeks. Now fine.
